value.rationale: The weight-12 base is the first nonsmooth variety in the motivic MZV toric construction. A complete reduced singular stratification with two different transverse ADE types, a crossing hypersurface, isolated threefold scroll cones, and an exact Q-Cartier obstruction is a natural geometric refinement relevant for studying its resolutions and canonical divisor, not an arbitrary sliced invariant.
